text: Welcome your newborn with the adhan (call to prayer) in the right ear and the iqamah (second call to prayer) in the left—let the first sound they hear be the name of Allah. Give them a beautiful name on the seventh day, and perform the aqiqah (sacrificial offering) in gratitude to the Creator.

review_defects.english: let the first sound they hear be the name of Allah
review_defects.why: The Arabic is a descriptive statement ('the first sound he hears is the name of Allah'), while the English turns it into an imperative ('let the first sound they hear be...'), shifting the mood from fact to command.
